tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam bshad legs par bshad pa zla 'od nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam bshad legs par bshad pa zla 'od nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (1) ༄༅// sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam bshad legs par bshad pa zla 'od nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (2) rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod ma'i sems sangs rgyas// sdom gsum lam gyi nyams su bstar ba las// mthar thug 'gro ba'i mgon gcig zas gtsang sras// ston mchog thub dbang zhabs la phyag bgyi 'o// rgyal ba nyid dang mi gnyis rgyal sras tshul// mi pham mgon dang 'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dpal// 'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs// rgya bod bstan 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs la 'dud// phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul kun dga' snying*// phyag na ral gri'i 'od 'bar bdun brgyud dang*// phyag na rdo rje'i stobs mnga' 'gro mgon rje// sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams rgyal gyur cig /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i cha shas yongs rdzogs rnam dkar 'phrin las bsil zer can// blo gsal gdul bya rgya mtsho'i gnyen gyur gnas lnga'i gzhung lugs ku mud 'byed// 'chad rtsod rtsom gyi (3) 'od brgya dang 'grogs skye dgu'i 'dren byed snang ba'i dpal// rgyal rnams mchog tu dges pa'i bshes gnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gang der 'dud// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs pa'i// dam chos smra ba'i sgra dbyangs srid na brel// phas rgol glang po'i klad 'gems gdong lnga pa// bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs kyis rtag tu skyong*// thub dbang bstan pa'i legs byas rin chen khrir// snying stobs ngal 'tsho dam chos bdud rtsi'i skyes// grangs med 'gro la sbyin pa'i pha rol son// byams dang thugs rje'i dpal mnga' bzang por 'dud// bshad sgrub mi nub bstan pa'i rgya mtsho las// blo gros nyin mo'i dbang phyug srid na shar// phan bde'i dpal yon skal bzang 'gro ba'i mig /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs pad gtsug gis mchod// yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa rma med pa// gsal ba'i 'dzum phreng dag byed rab dbye'i

(4) gtam// mdo sngags chos kun yongs 'du'i rkang 'thung dris// phyogs kun khyab byed rnam bshad deng 'dir spro// sngon tshe thub pa'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i// dam tshig ral pa stug po'i khur lci ba// phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs byed chos srung gis// 'phral dang yun du shis pa'i dge legs sgrubs// 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba 'chad par byed pa la don gsum ste/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i che ba'i yon tan/ des bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul/ brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi brjod bya gtan la phab pa'o// dang po ni/ chu pho stag lo'i dpyid zla nyer drug la// shes rab zag med yum la bltams pa'i tshe// 'od dang ltas bzang rnam pa du ma rnams// zas gtsang sras ltar ngo mtshar dpag med byung*// zhes pa ltar/ dbo zla ba'i nyer drug gi nyin lung pa 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro mang po 'du ba dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ltas khyad par can dang bcas nas sku bltams shing*/ de nas lo gcig tsam song ba na/ sa la lañdza dang wa rtu'i ā li kā li rnams bris nas/ saṃ skri ta'i skad du klog par mdzad pas/ rgya bod kyi klog dang yi ge yang rang babs su mkhyen pa yin te/ rnam thar bsdus pa las/ chos kyi ma mo ma bslabs thugs su chud// ces pa'i don yang 'di yin no// de nas thog mar rje btsun rin po che'i drung du tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen so thar gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' rgyal mtshan du btags/ lugs gnyis kyi cho ga'i sgo nas byang chub (5) mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bcug cing mngon par dbang bskur ba'i sgo nas sngags kyi sdom pa yang nos te/

sdom gsum gsum rim can du stsal ba'i bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ rje btsun rin po che nyid yin no// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na bstan bcos 'di'i dbur sdom gsum ster pa po'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par brjod pa 'byung ba la shes byed dang 'thad pa mang du yod do// de yang rje btsun rin po che ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i skye ba mang po'i bar gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ lhag pa'i lha tha mi dad pa de yin te/ sa skyar chos gsung ba'i nam mkhar rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan byon nas/ khyod mi nas mir gyur pa'i skye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur/ de'i bar gyi bla ma nga yin/ de las gzhan khyod sus kyang 'dul bar 'os pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ phyis skya bo kha gdangs su yang*/ chos gsung ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin byung bas sngar gyi de dran gsung ngo*/ de skad du/ sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu las kyang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs// dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan nas// bdag gi 'khrul pa'i dra ba bcad// yun ring dus nas 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes// mkha' la de lta'i sgra bsgrags pa// legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rnam thar bsdus pa las/ mi nas mir gyur skye ba nyi shu lngar// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung gyur cing*// bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /mtshungs bral khyod (6) la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs so// des na chos dang 'jig rten gyi dge legs kyi rten 'brel thams cad kyang rje btsun rin po che nyid las 'grig pa yin te/ skabs shig rje btsun rin po che bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis phyag phyi'i ngal ba lhur blangs shing mos gus rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/

rje btsun yang thugs mnyes te/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang*/ de nas bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs pas/ chos thams cad kyi gnad phyin ci ma log par go ba'i rnam dpyod kyi blo gros nang nas brdol te/ phyi shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la thogs med kyis mkhyen pa dang*/ phas kyi rgol ba kun zil gyis gnon nus pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa mnga'/ rgya bod kyi rgyal po dregs pa can rnams kyang 'dud pa sogs lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad dbang du 'dus/ nang du yang phyi rol gyi g.yeng rkyen gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun brtan po byung ba yin gsung*/ de skad du/ zab mo'i lam gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe// rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs// skad cig gcig la chos rnams thugs su chud// thugs grol khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa spel tshul ni/ dgung lo dgu par/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang*/ gsang sngags phra mo ci rigs gsungs/ bcu gcig pa'i dus su brtag gnyis dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ bcu gnyis pa'i dus su gur dang saṃ bu ṭa gsungs pa nas/ bdun cu'i bar du mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bshad pa rgyun ma chad par mdzad cing*/ khyad par kha che paṇa chen la (7) tshad ma gsan pa'i rjes su/ rje de nyid kyi bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir nyin re bzhin tshad ma'i chos thun re chag med du dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa la rgya nag la ma gshegs kyi bar du gsungs/ de yang sras kyi gtso bo shar nub gung gsum/ khang gnyan zhang gsum/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge sogs la bshad nyan mdzad pas/ rnam 'grel gyi bshad srol deng sang gi bar du nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad pa 'di yin no// bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi snyan pa'i grags pas rgya gar shar nub kun tu'ang khyab pa'i tshe/

'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa'i phyi rol pa rnams kyi phrag dog gis ma bzod par rtsod par brtsams te/ mang yul spyi rong du nyi ma bcu gsum gyi bar du rtsod pa mdzad pas/ phyi rol ba rnams pham zhing*/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i phyag dpung g.yas par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mngon sum du byon nas rtsod pa'i grogs mdzad/ de'i tshe 'phrog byed dga' bos/ khyon min khyod kyi phrag pa g.yas pa yi// dmar ser ral gri can de ma thub pas// de bas khyod rgyal nga ni pham par gyur// zhes zer zhing nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'gros par brtsams pas/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar char gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i dbyings mthon po nas bkug ste/ bdag nyid chen po'i drung du ral pa'i khur bregs nas rab tu byung zhing*/ de'i tshe/ rgya mtsho'i gos can rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas sa chen 'di na lha chen po// zhes pa nas/ da dung du yang mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham byas nas// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i tshul// kun dga'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad gsungs shing*/ ral ba rnams rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i snyan (8) grags dril bsgrogs pa'i rten du/ da lta yang dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang gi ka rgyan la yod do// de skad du/ rtog ge ngan pa'i rgol ba thams cad bzlog /rlom pas khengs pa'i rtog ge zil gyis mnan// mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab// 'jigs bral khyed la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// de ltar 'chad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis gdul ba blo gsal gyi pad+mo kha phye ba dang*/ rtsod pa gnam lcags kyi thog gis rgol ngan gyi brag ri snyil ba'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad par ma zad/ sdeb legs rtsom gyi phreng bas kyang sa chen po'i khor yug kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa rma med pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin te/

chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la mdo rgyud kun gyi glegs bam gcig tu gyur pa bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa dang rigs pa ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la sde bdun gyi snying po tshad ma rigs pa'i gter dang*/ 'jig rten gyi tshul dang tshul min rnam par 'byed pa la legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter dang gsum po 'di ni dpyod ldan gyi mig bu lta bur gyur cing*/ srid mtha'i bar du yang yang dag pa'i lam gyi snang ba ches cher gsal bar ston pa la tshad thub kyi gzhung yin no// gzhan yang theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len ma lus pa gsal bar ston pa la thub pa dgongs gsal dang*/ rdo rje theg pa la bdag med bstod 'grel la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pa dang*/ rab dbye las 'phros pa'i dka' ba'i gnas kyi dris lan mang po dang*/ rab dbye'i snying po bsdu ba'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul che long tsam brjod de/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la lhag par bskrul ba'i (9) bstan bcos phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu la sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma dang*/ sgra'i bstan bcos mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo dang*/ sgra nye bar bsdu ba la sogs pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos me tog gi chun po dang*/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos tshig gi gter dang*/ zlos gar gyi bstan bcos rab dga'i 'jug pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa mdzad de/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir lnga rig shes bya'i gnas kun la mkhyen pa'i blo gros thogs pa med pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ches mchog tu gyur pa ni bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid yin no// mthar bdag nyid chen po'i snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzam gling kun tu khyab pa'i tshe/ rgya nag gi rgyal po go dan gyi dor ta zhes bya ba'i spyan 'dren pho nya mngags te/ de yang rgyal po nged kyi lung*/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i go bar byed pa'i gtam/

nged kyi pha ma dang gnam sa'i drin len bsab pa'i phyir mchod gnas shig dgos pa/ brtag pa byas pas khyed 'os su shar bas/ lam gyi dka' tshegs la ma 'dzem par yong dgos/ gal te khyed na so rgas so zhe na/ sngon thub pa'i dbang pos sems can gyi don du lus grangs med sbyin par btang ba mi dran nam/ des kyang mi yong na nga'i mtha'i dmag dpung chen po bskul nas sems can mang po la gnod pa byas na khyod mi skrag pa e yin/ zhes sogs kyi 'phrin yig dang*/ gnang sbyin gyi rten du gos chen lu hang gser mdog gi ring 'gag sogs khyad par can gyi dngos po tshad med pa dang bcas pa 'byor pas/ sngar bla ma rje btsun chen pos khyod nyid tshe gzhug tu/ mi rigs mi gcig sum brgya drug cu'i yul/ skad rigs mi gcig bdun brgya nyi shu'i skad sgrog pa byang (10) nas byang phyogs rgyal khams hor gyi yul nas/ zhwa khra 'dra ba/ lham phag sna 'dra ba gyon pa'i dor ta zhes pa'i rkang mgyogs btang nas 'bod du byung ba'i tshe/ the tshom ma byed par myur du song zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sems can la phan pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*// zhes lung bstan pa dran nas/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing pho 'brug gi lo la/ dpal ldan sa skya nas sku'i dbon po 'phags pa sku mched gnyis dang bcas pa byon te/ drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho rta'i lo la/ pho brang chen po ling chu rtser phyags phebs/ de'i tshe rgyal po go dan hor yul du song ba tshur byon pa dang*/ lug lo zla ba dang po la mjal/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ rgyal po la theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mang po gnang nas/ hor gyi rgyal khams dkon mchog mchod pa sogs dge ba sgrub pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i las lam cha shas kyis spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'jug par mdzad do// de ltar rgya hor gyi yul du rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/

snga mor bdag nyid chen po nyid kyi gsung las kyang*/ bdag kyang sngon gyi byed pa 'ga' yis rgyus// bstan pa'i nyi ma shar gyi phyogs su 'cha'// zhes dang*/ rje btsun chen po byang gi nyi lung phug par bzhugs dus/ hor gyi cha lugs can gyi rta mi sa gzhi go bkab pa tsam byung ba la/ nye gnas kyis ci yin bsams pa la/ thams cad bla ma rje btsun nyid bzhugs pa'i phug pa'i nang du chud nas sku mdun du 'khod de/ khye'u g.yu'i thor tshugs can/ dung so khor mar byas pa zhig langs nas/ hor gyi skad rnams bod skad du bsgyur nas zhu ba 'di ltar/ (11) nged hor gyi pho lha gnam sde dkar po bya ba yin pas/ rje btsun nyid hor yul du byon nas lha mi thams cad la phan par mdzad du gsol zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga na so yang rgas/ khyed hor dang las 'brel cher med pas/ ma 'ongs phan pa'i tsha bo kun dga' rgyal mtshan spyan drongs des phan pa rgya chen po 'byung gsungs pa/ khye'u des hor skad du bsgyur nas hor rnams la smra bar byed/ khye'u de ni dri za'i rgyal po gnyan chen thang lha lo tsā la yong ba yin/ der rje btsun gyis nang mchod nas yi ge 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs shing hor rnams la gtor bas/ khong rnams ni mtshan thog thag bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i snang ba byed cing*/ hor gyi skad du glu len zhing*/ bro 'khrab/ sang nam langs pa dang*/ tshang ma thegs song ba dang*/ yang rje btsun nyid cha lung rdo rje'i breg rdzong du sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs dus/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos bye ru'i skas btsugs nas mkha' dbyings mthon por spyan drangs te/ rgya hor gyi rgyal khams kun gsal bar bstan nas 'di dag khyod kyi gdul bya yin zer ba la/ nga dang hor las 'brel cher med pas/ ma 'ongs pa na nga'i tsha bo 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gdul bya 'di dag yong ba gyis gsung ba'i bka' bsgos mdzad par brten/

phyis su rgya hor gyi rgyal khams kun bdag nyid chen po khu dbon brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gdul byar gyur cing*/ kha che paṇa chen rgya gar shar phyogs gser 'od rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya nag gi rgyal po'i spyan 'dren gyi pho nya byung ba'i tho rangs kyi dus su 'phags pa spyan ras

(12) gzigs kyi sprul pa'i dge slong mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhig gis/ da lta khyed kyis 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs/ bod yul du khyed kyi slob ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa zhig 'byung ba de'i gdul bya yin no// zhes lung bstan pa dang yang mthun no// des na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni nges par bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul par gdon mi za ste/ kha che paṇa chen sing ga la'i gling du byon pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa zhig gis me tog ser po zhig gtad nas/ khyed bod du byon pa na me tog 'di gang du kha bye ba na 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa zhig 'ong bas de la phul zhig ces lung bstan pa/ phyis sa skyar bdag nyid chen po dang mjal dus me tog de kha bye ba dang*/ yang bdag nyid chen po ling chu rtser khang na bzhugs pa na mi mang po zhig gis ri bo rtse lnga la mchod pa la phyin pas/ thams cad kyi rmi lam du da lta 'jam dbyangs ri bo rtse lnga na mi bzhugs/ ling chu rtser khab na chos gsung gin yod zer ba rmis te/ thams cad kyis ling chur 'ongs pas bdag nyid chen po chos gsung gin bzhugs pa dang mjal ba yin no// de bzhin du jau bo rje bod la byon dus sa skya dan gyi phyogs de dag gzigs pa na 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud 'byung bar lung bstan cing*/ yar klungs pa byang chub rgyal mtshan/ bo dong rin po che la sogs pa'i slob ma las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang*/ bdag nyid chen po 'di 'jam dbyangs su dngos su gzigs pa dang*/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sgo gong gi ngos la yang*/ bdag nyid chen po'i mtshan saṃ skṛ ta'i yi ger rang shar la byung bas 'jam dbyangs zhes gtam du grags so// de skad du/ rnam thar chen mo las/ bdag dang dad pa thob pa'i slob ma 'gas// (13) bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su yang yang gzigs// zhes dang*/ rnam thar bsdus pa las/ bsam pa dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis// 'jam pa'i dbyangs su mig gis mthong gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i yul du'ang gtam du de ltar grags// lhun grub khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// don de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/

gang sku bltams tshe phyogs kun 'od kyis khyab// mkha' 'gro rnams kyang ring nas 'du ba dang*// me tog char 'bab dge mtshan du ma ni// sngon tshe thub dbang bltams dang khyad par ci// chos kyi ma mo yi ge'i rigs rnams kun// ma bslabs mkhyen pa'i ri mo sa la ni// gsal ba'i 'dzum phreng 'phags pa'i spyod yul che// byis blos ring du sbyang kun 'dar ba bzhin// rje btsun mchog las bstan rtsa sdom gsum gyi// bka' drin bdud rtsi'i sgo brgya rab phye ste// kun dga' rgyal mtshan mtshan gyi dge legs sgras// 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gsal bar byas// sa skyar chos gsung mdun gyi mkha' dbyings khrir// yang srid skye ba bcu phrag gnyis dang lngar// dge ba'i bshes su zhal bzhes dbugs dbyung zhing*// slad nas kha gdangs su yang dbugs dbyung stsal// lam zab bla ma'i byin rlabs thugs rgyud smin// 'phral dang yun gyi dge legs rten 'brel gyis// blo gros mi zad gter kha de nas phye// e ma mchog thun dngos grub nam mkha'i mdzod// bgrang gzhi dgu par sgrub thabs mtsho skyes nas// bcu phrag ris bsgyur bar du mdo dang rgyud// rig gnas bcas pa'i chos kun skal bzang la// 'doms mdzad rgyal ba nyid dang zhal mi gnyis// (14) phas rgol glang po'i stobs ldan rtog ge pa// 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs drug phrag gis// rtsod par sems pa'i byis blo'i me khyer ni// smra ba'i nyi mas mngon bcom zil gyis mnan// 'phags yul 'gran zla bral ba'i phyi rol pa// bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi mkhas pas zil mnan pa// 'phags mchog blo gros mi zad 'jam dpal de// mngon sum bod yul byon nas rtsod par nges// sa chen khor yug kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan// rma med ches cher gsal ba'i ngo mtshar gtam// rab dbye rigs pa'i gter dang legs bshad gter// sdeb legs yid 'phrog du mas thub bstan mdzes// snyan grags rin chen rna rgyan phyogs kun gyi// ri dwags mig can sgra 'dzin mdzes byas pas// rgya hor rgyal khams lha mir bcas kun gyis// rings par dad pa'i pho nya khyod drung brel// rje btsun bla ma dges pa'i zhal 'dzum las// lung bstan bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i so pa yis// bstan pa'i gtso de rgyal sras mched dang bcas// shar phyogs bgrod par snying stobs dal gyis bskyod// lug lo zla ba dang po'i dkar phyogs la// mchod yon nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor zhal 'dzom tshe// 'gro kun yi rang phan bde'i zil dngar gyis// 'dzin ma'i khyon kun de nas rab tu khengs// sa 'dzin rtse lnga'i bdag po rang nyid ni// re zhig bod kyi yul grur mi yi zol// skrad nas rang gi gdul bya lhag dran pas// rang gi zhing khams bder son rnam dkar skyong*// skal bzang dad pa'i sgrib bral mig gis ni// khyod nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rjer yang yang gzigs// kha chen paṇa chen rgya gar shar phyogs kyi// gser 'od rgyal mtshan bzhugs tshe spyan ras gzigs// dge slong zol

(15) gyis rgya hor rgyal khams ni// khyod kyis 'dul ba'i 'os min bod yul gyi// slob ma 'jam dbyangs sprul pas 'dul zhes pa'i// lung bstan rna ba'i bdud rtsi de na khol// sing ga la yi gling nas dgra bcom pa// 'phags pa mngon shes drug pas me tog 'di// gang du phye sar 'jam dbyangs sprul pa la// phul zhes lung bstan sa skya'i gnas su smin// mar me mdzad dpal 'gro ba'i mgon po yis// sa dkar logs kyi dhī yig rten 'brel las// 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud lung bstan 'chi med rnga*// phyogs kyi mdzes mas srid mtha'i bar du brdungs// de phyir mgon khyod rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// yab gcig 'jam pa'i rdo rjer des 'dongs pas// bdag dang 'gro kun tshad med thugs rje yis// rjes bzung byang chub bar du skyong bar mdzod// ces so// gnyis pa ji ltar brtsam pa'i tshul ni/ chos kyi rje sa skya pa chen po gshegs pa'i rjes su/ sems bskyed rmi lam ma la sogs par chos log mang du 'phel ba rnams dgag par bzhed nas/ bstan bcos 'di brtsams te phyed tsam tshar ba na/ bod kyi chos pa rnams kyis chags sdang gi dbang gis brtsams 'dug zer nas/ chos nyan du 'ong ba rnams kyi gegs su song ba'i gtam/ zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyis thos pas/ dbu che ba rnams ngo chen du sbran te/ chags sdang can zer ba'i gtam 'di 'o skol gyi 'phrin las la gnod par gda' bas/ mi rtsom par zhu zhes zhu ba phul bas/ chos 'di lo 'dod dam nga rgyal gyis byas pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan par bsams pa yin te/ thams cad ma dga' bar 'dug pas (16) bzhag pa las 'os med gsungs nas mi rtsom par zhal gyis bzhes so// de'i mtshan mo sangs rgyas kyi sku shin tu mtshar ba zhig mi gtsang ba'i khrod na 'dug pa la byi dor byas pas mi mang po mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed kyin 'dug pas bzhag pa dang*/

slar yang sku de la mi mang pos mi gtsang ba bsku ba dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku rgyab bstan pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub byang chub kyi shing bskams po la sku rgyab rten nas bsnyung ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa la sogs pa rmis nas/ mnal sad pa dang*/ bstan bcos 'di brtsams na mi mi dga' bar 'dug kyang*/ ma brtsams na lha mi dga' bar 'dug pas brtsam dgos gsungs shing*/ sngar mi rtsom par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i nyes pa bla ma dang dkon mchog la bzod par gsol te yongs su rdzogs pa brtsams pa yin no// gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya gtan la phab pa la gnyis te/ bsdus don gyi sgo nas gzhung gi khog phub pa dang*/ tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba'i sgo nas gzhung don zhib tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bstan bcos 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyams len thams cad sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len du 'dus shing*/ sdom pa gsum ni bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ de yang so thar sdom pa'i nyams len la/ nyan thos so thar dang*/ theg chen so thar gnyis las/ nyan thos so thar la/ gtan khrims bdun ni ji srid 'tsho'i mtha' can yin/ rten gyi gang zag shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ba'i sgrub byed rgyas par bshad nas/ 'bri gung pa rnams shi phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang bar 'dod pa'i log rtogs (17) dgag pa ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa la// nyan thos theg chen lugs gnyis yod// ces pa nas/ sde snod rnam dbye med par zad// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bsnyen gnas so thar la/ blang ba'i yul dang len pa'i gang zag sogs nyan thos nang phan tshun dang*/ theg pa che chung ma 'dres par bshad nas/ bka' gdams pa rnams bsnyen gnas 'bul ba dang*/ gzhan la 'chol ba dang*/ lha bsgom tha dad pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ bye brag smra ba'i bsnyen gnas kyang*// zhes pa nas/

yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ theg chen so thar la/ cho ga nub pa dang*/ ma nub pa sogs kyi dbye ba so sor phye nas deng sang lag len du 'os pa'i cho ga bye brag tu 'chad pa ni/ theg pa chen po las byung ba'i// zhes pa nas/ byang sems so sor thar pa 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ theg chen so thar len pa'i cho ga la 'phros nas/ theg chen so thar gyi bslab bya'i khyad par bye brag tu 'chad pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi// zhes pa nas/ de 'dra'i rnam dbye shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ zhar la de'i gtong tshul ni/ theg chen so sor thar yin yang*// zhes pa nas/ de yi 'bras bu shi yang 'byung*// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka mthun par las 'bras la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa ni/ so thar gyi bslab bya'i gtso bo yin pas/ de 'chad pa ni/ de nas las dang rnam smin gyi// zhes pa nas/ da gzod las kyi rgyu 'bras la// shin tu mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ las 'bras la 'phros nas/ bod kyi zhang g.yu brag pa sogs gshis la dge sdig yod par 'dod pa'i log (18) rtog dang*/ 'bri gung pa kha cig las kyi 'bras bu dkar nag zang thal du 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ rim pa bzhin du/ mu stegs grangs can pa rnams ni// zhes pa nas/ mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ nyan thos dge ba phal cher yang*// zhes pa nas/ mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin shes par gyis// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bslab bya khyad par la 'phros nas/ 'bri gung pa kha cig theg pa che chung gi bslab bya la/ gcig la bkag pa thams cad la ye nas bkag pa dang*/ gcig la gnang ba thams cad la ye nas gnang bar 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba'ang*// sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun pa min// zhes pa nas/ bslab pa 'cha' dang sngags sbyor ba'i// byed po sangs rgyas yin par gsungs// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/

nyan thos so thar gyi dgag pa'i bslab bya sbu gu can dang*/ gong ba can sogs 'dul ba'i spyod pa ma yin pas spang dgos pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya mdo bskul sogs 'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par bya dgos par 'chad pa ni/ sbu gu can dang gong ba can// zhes sogs dang*/ mdo bskul la sogs bya ba kun// 'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par gyis// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bod dag sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnam dag la nyan bshad mi byed par/ blun po rnams kyis rang dgar sbyar ba'i bstan bcos la nyan bshad byed pa po ni ches blun zhing 'khrul pa yin pas/ de bkag nas thos bsam sgom gsum ma nor bar bsgrub tshul 'chad pa ni/ la la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// zhes pa nas/ (19) 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa byang sems sdom pa'i nyams len ni/ spyir sems bskyed la/ nyan thos lugs dang*/ theg chen lugs gnyis las/ dang po la/ theg pa gsum gyi sems bskyed gsum dang*/ phyi ma la dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis yod cing*/ de gnyis la yang dang po len pa'i cho ga dang*/ bslab bya sogs tha dad du yod do zhes spyir bstan pa ni/ sems bskyed la ni zhes pa nas// bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ cho ga'i skabs su bka' gdams pa kha cig sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed skye bo kun la byed pa dang*/ don dam sems bskyed cho gas len pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ rim pa bzhin du/ sems tsam pa yi sems bskyed 'di// zhes sogs dang*/ don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bslab bya'i skabs su/ dbu sems thun mong du ltung ba'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'bri gung pa kha cig bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom du mi rung bar 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ rim bzhin/

de ltar sems tsam dbu ma gnyis// zhes sogs dang*/ byang chub sems kyi bslab pa la// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de ltar sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang*/ bslab bya'i 'og tu sems bskyed kyi nyams len gyi gnad ma 'phyugs pa dgos tshul bye brag tu 'chad pa ni/ sems bskyed kyi nyams len gyi gnad 'phyugs na 'tshang mi rgya bar bstan pa/ gnad 'phyugs pa ma dag pa'i sbyin sogs ngos bzung ba/ lhag bsam dag pas thos sgom ma 'khrul par byed par gdams pa gsum rim pa bzhin du/ byang (20) chub sems kyi gnad 'phyugs na// zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes par// zhes sogs dang*/ mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan// ༈ //gsum pa sngags kyi sdom pa'i nyams len la/ smin byed nor ba med pa'i dbang bzhi/ grol byed 'khrul pa med pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po/ phyag rgya chen po goms pa las 'khor 'das bsre ba'i spyod pa spyad pa/ de la brten nas sa lam bgrod de 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len thams cad smin grol gnyis su 'dus pa las/ smin byed kyi dbang ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig gis rgyud sde la gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor du cho ga 'khrul pa med pas dbang bskur ba la brten/ slob mas sngags sdom thob pa de la 'jog pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te// zhes pa nas/ de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ deng sang bod 'dir phyag rgya pa kha cig byin rlabs tsam smin byed kyi dbang du 'dod pa/ grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed pa/ dkyil 'khor ma dag par dbang bskur byed pa/ cho ga ma dag par dbang bskur byed pa/ dbang bskur med kyang zab lam bsgom pa/ dbang po rab 'bring phye nas smra ba/ sems bskyed tsam gyis gsang sngags sgom pa/

gtor ma dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur smin byed du 'dod pa/ dbang bskur phyi nas khas len byed pa/ sems nyid rtogs na dbang bskur mi dgos par 'dod pa/ cho ga med par bla ma'i lus dkyil tsam las smin byed len pa/ bya rgyud sogs la'ang dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis yod par 'dod pa/

(21) sngags la mos pa chos sgo byas pas zab phal bsgom rung du 'dod pa/ dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dang bcu bzhi tsam byung ba rim pa bzhin du dgag pa ni/ deng sang rdo rje phag mo yi// zhes sogs kyis dang po dang*/ des na nyan thos theg pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis gnyis pa dang*/ deng sang byin rlabs mi byed cing*// zhes sogs kyis gsum pa dang*/ dbang bskur byed pa phal cher yang*// zhes sogs kyis bzhi pa dang*/ dbang bskur med kyang lam zab mo// zhes sogs kyis lnga pa dang*/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab// ces sogs kyis drug pa dang*/ la la sems bskyed byas pa la// zhes sogs kyis bdun pa dang*/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya dang*// zhes sogs kyis brgyad pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gsang sngags da lta spyod// ces sogs kyis dgu pa dang*/ la la sems nyid ma rtogs na// zhes sogs kyis bcu pa dang*/ kha cig cho ga med bzhin du// zhes sogs kyis bcu gcig pa dang*/ kha cig bya ba'i rgyud sogs la'ang*// zhes sogs kyis bcu gnyis pa dang*/ la la dbang bskur ma byas kyang*// zhes sogs kyis bcu gsum pa dang*/ la la dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod// ces sogs kyis bcu bzhi pa dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dgag pa bstan/ zhar la kha cig gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba med par 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ kha cig gsang sngags gsang ba la// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ grol phyed rim gnyis la phyag rgya pa kha cig sngon gyi grub thob rnams thabs lam re re bas grol ba yin pas rim pa gnyis char bsgom pa la dgos pa med do zhes smra ba rnams bkag nas/ sa skya pa rang lugs la bla med kyi lam rim pa gnyis su bsgrubs te (22) 'tshang rgya ba la thabs shes cha tshang ba dgos so// zhes pa ni/ kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med// ces pa nas/ de phyir 'di la mkhas rnams gus// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de las 'phros nas/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom gsum len tshul/

sngags kyi lam bskyed rim dang gtum mo sgom tshul/ mdo sngags kyi bla ma'i khyad par rnams la 'khrul pa 'gog pa dang*/ gnad kyi don sdom pa dang mi ldan na dge sbyong du mi 'gyur/ sems bskyed ma thob na rgyal sras su mi 'gyur/ dbang bskur ma thob na gsang sngags par mi 'gyur ro// zhes pa ni/ gang dag rab tu 'byung 'dod na// zhes pa nas/ sngags pa dbang bskur med pa gsum// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chom rkun yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i ye shes phyag chen la/ mtshon byed dpe dang*/ mtshon bya don gnyis las/ dang po'i skabs su/ cho ga 'ga' zhig gi byed pas rtog pa nang du kha tshom pa tsam la/ phyag chen du 'dod pa bkag nas/ rang lugs kyi phyag chen ngos gzung ba dang*/ gzhan lugs kyi phyag chen rgya nag lugs su bstan pa sogs ni/ phyag rgya chen po sgom na yang*// zhes pa nas/ byin rlabs sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de las 'phros nas/ kha cig da lta gsang sngags kyi chos la dad pa che na/ skye ba snga mar dbang bskur thob pa zhig yin pas/ da lta phyag chen gyi rgyur dbang bskur ba mi dgos zer ba dgag pa ni/ kha cig skye ba snga ma la// zhes pa nas/ de la kho bo ngo mtshar skyes// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan// mtshon bya don la/ kha cig zhi gnas cung zad tsam dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug gi rtog pa phra mo skyes pa la mthong lam du ngo sprod byed pa dgag pa ni/ la la zhi gnas cung (23) zad dang*// zhes pa nas/ des na nged kyi mthong lam ni// 'phags pa min la 'byung mi srid// ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ zhar las 'phros pa theg pa gsum gyi lag len dang*/ theg pa che chung gi bla ma'i dbye ba dang*/ dbang bskur dang po sogs ma thob par de dang de'i lam bsgom pa dgag pa dang*/ gtor ma dang phud mchod kyi lag len la 'khrul pa 'gog pa dang*/ lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan la 'khrul pa 'gog pa dang*/

rab gnas dang sbyin sreg gsang 'dus sogs mdo lugs su 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ rim bzhin/ theg pa gsum ka'i lag len yang*// zhes sogs dang*/ nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma ni// zhes sogs dang*/ dbang bskur dang po ma thob par// zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na// zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba yi// zhes sogs dang*/ yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ rtogs bya spros bral gyi lta ba la/ theg pa rim pa dgu la lta ba tha dad yod par 'dod pa dang*/ dbu ma nas bzung ste gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi la lta ba tha dad yod par 'dod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi la lta ba tha dad yod par 'dod pa rnams dgag pa ni/ rim bzhin/ la la theg pa rim dgu la// zhes sogs dang*/ kha cig dbu ma'i lta ba ni// zhes sogs dang*/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba rnams ni// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ zhar la rgyud sde bzhi'i sgrub thabs la 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ rgyud sde bzhi yi sgrub pa yang*// zhes pa nas/ rang bzo'i rnam thar spyod pa mtshar// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa spyod pa ni/ blang dor gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa brtan pa chen po la gnas pa des/ nang gi gnas sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rlung sems dbu mar thim ste sa (24) bcu gsum pa'i rtogs pa rnams bgrod par bya ba dang*/ phyi rol 'dzam gling gi yul pul+lī ra ma la ya la sogs pa'i yul rnams dang*/ der gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dbang du bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir/ phyi rol gyi yul chen so bdun du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la rgyu ba yin pa las/ bod 'dir ni/ dbang bskur dang rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa ci yang med pa la sgom chen du rlom pa dag spyod pa la rgyu ba dang*/ gang du rgyu ba'i gnas kyang ti se la gangs can du 'khrul pa dang*/ tsa ri la tsa ri tra ru 'khrul pa rnams 'gog pa ni/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// zhes pa nas/

yul der 'gro ba rgyud las bkag /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lam thabs shes zung 'jug bsgoms pa las 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa yang zung 'jug yin pa zhig thob mod kyang*/ kha cig dkar po chig thub las 'bras bu sku gsum 'byung bar 'dod pa dang*/ zung 'jug bsgoms pa las 'bras bu 'od gsal gcig tu 'dod pa dang*/ sa lam ma bgrod par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang*/ dbang bzhi dang lam bzhi med par 'bras bu sku bzhi 'dod pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i mthar thug 'od gsal du 'dod pa rnams 'gog pa ni/ kha cig dkar po chig thub las// zhes pa nas/ ldang ba mthar thug yin par gsungs// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ sa dang po yan chad thob pa la grub thob ces pa'i bsnyad mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun par gsungs la/ de las gzhan rtogs ldan nyid ched du bzang bar ma gsungs kyang*/ kha cig grub thob las rtogs ldan bzang zhes pa dang*/ nyams ngan la go ba 'bring rtogs pa bzang bar 'dod pa dang*/ rtse (25) gcig tu spros bral sogs kyi rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa dang sbyor ba dgag pa ni/ rim bzhin/ la la grub thob ngan zhes zer// zhes sogs dang*/ la la nyams dang go ba dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ rtse gcig dang ni spros bral dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de yan chad kyis sdom gsum so so'i skabs bstan zin nas/ da ni gzhung spyi la rtsod pa spang ba sogs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba ston te/ de yang theg pa rang sa na bden pas dgag bsgrub la nges pa med do zhes smra ba 'gog pa dang*/ chos kyi gnad ma 'phyugs pa gal che bar ston pa dang*/ gnad bcos pa'i bdud ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gleng gzhi dang bcas te ston pa dang*/ 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' lung rigs kyis sun 'byin pa'i tshul gleng gzhi dang bcas te ston pa dang*/

bye brag tu lung gis sun 'byin pa'i tshul/ lung sbyor ji ltar byed pa'i tshul/ khungs nas ma byungaba'i gdams ngag dang mdo rgyud du grags pa rnams tshad mar mi rung bar bstan pa dang*/ sku gzugs ring bsrel dang glo bur gyi ltas rnams mkhas pa la dris nas rtog spyod bya dgos par bstan pa dang*/ tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ kha cig theg pa rang sa na// zhes sogs dang*/ chos gzhan legs par ston na yang*// zhes sogs dang*/ de la gnad rnams bcos pa'i bdud// ces sogs dang*/ 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' sun 'byin pa'i// zhes sogs dang*/ gal te lung dang 'gal gyur na// zhes sogs dang*/ blun po mkhas par 'chos pa 'ga'// zhes sogs dang*/ snyan brgyud dang ni chig brgyud du// zhes sogs dang*/ ring bsrel dang ni thugs dang ljags// zhes sogs dang*/ de nas tshig la 'khrul pa yi// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ sangs rgyas gsung rab dri ma med// ces sogs (26) kyis ni/ sngar rgya bod du chos log byung ba rnams skyes chen gong mas bkag tshul rgyas par bshad nas/ deng sang chos log 'phel ba rnams kyang 'gog rigs par bstan/ bdag ni sems can kun la byams// zhes sogs kyis bstan bcos rtsom pa'i kun slong lhag bsam rnam par dag pa bstan/ bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma bslabs// zhes sogs kyis ni bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu mkhas pa'i shes rab bstan pa yin no// de dag gis ni spyir gzhung don 'chad pa'i tshul la/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ bsdus don gyi sgo nas gzhung 'chad tshul yin la/ de la yang gzhung spyi'i bsdus don dang*/ gzhung so so'i bsdus don gnyis las/ 'di dag ni phyi ma yin te/ gzhung gi dbu zhabs ma lus pa'i don bsdus pa'i sgo nas khog phub pa ni/ gzhung so so'i bsdus don dang*/ gzhung spyi'i lus rnam par bzhag pa tsam ni gzhung spyi'i bsdus don yin pas so// de skad du/

mkhas 'jug las/ bsdus pa'i don la rnam gnyis te/ ngag don bsdus te bstan pa dang*// gzhung don so so'i bsdus don no// don 'dus tshig gsal brjod pa bde// ngag nyung tshig snyoms bzung ba sla// bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba// de 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas// zhes so// gnyis pa tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba'i sgo nas gzhung don zhib par bshad pa la gsum ste/ brjod byed bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched du mtshan gyi don/ bstan pa rnam dag tu bsgrub pa'i ched du gzhung gi don/ byas shes drin bzo bskyed pa'i ched du mdzad byang smos pa'o// dang po ni/ bshad bya bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan ji lta bu zhe na/ bstan bcos 'di chos can/ khyod la so thar (27) byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa dang gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ste/ brjod bya sdom pa gsum po de dang por len pa'i cho ga bar du bsrung ba'i bslab bya/ mthar 'bras bu 'byin pa'i tshul/ nyams len gyi gnad so so dang bcas pa la 'khrul pa bkag nas/ ma 'khrul bar bsgrub pa'i rnam dbye'i ngag yin pas so// sor sdom sogs gsum la sdom pa gsum gyi tha snyad ni rgyud rdo rje'i rtse mo las bshad pa yin te/ de nyid las/ sdom pa gsum dang yang dag ldan// so so thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin rang gi ngo bo 'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab mnyam du 'khrul par mi bya ste/ rdo rje rtse mo'i dngos bstan ni gsum ldan gyi rgyud kyi sdom gsum so so yin pas/ don la sngags sdom nyid yin la/ skabs 'di'i sor sdom byang sdom gnyis ni sngags kyi rtsis ma zin pa kho na yin pa'i rnam dbye gces so// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bshad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag bshad pa rang gi ngo bo/ bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ rtsom par dam bca' ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ bla ma dam pa spyi la mchod par brjod pa/

sdom gsum ster ba po'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod par brjod pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa 'cha' ba po'i ston pa sangs rgyas la mchod par brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ bla ma'i skad dod la gu ru zhes pa 'byung zhing*/ de'i sgra las drangs ni lci ba ste/ dge slong ma'i lci ba'i chos la bla ma'i chos zhes bsgyur ba ltar yon tan gyi khur gyis lci bas na bla ma/ slob mas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab na/ tshe 'di'am bar do sogs su sangs rgyas 'byin par nus pas dam pa ste/ cho ga rnam par dag pas bla med (28) kyi dbang rdzogs par bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyi zhabs la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'chad pa la/ bla ma zhes sogs byung*/ bla ma dam pa'i don la/ sgra pa sher rin pas rtsal ston pa la/ rang gi rnyed bkur nyams pa la thugs mi 'khrug cing*/ slob ma'i yon tan nyams pas thugs 'khrug pa ni dam pa dang*/ rang gi rnyed bkur nyams pas thugs 'khrug pa ni dam pa ma yin par 'grel chen dri med 'od las bshad gsungs pa dang*/ dga' gdong pas las dam pa dge ba la 'jug cing*/ mi dge ba mi byed pa ni dam pa dang*/ de las ldog pa ni dam pa ma yin pa'o// zhes 'chad pa dang*/ yang dpyod ldan kha cig bla med kyi rdo rje slob dpon spyi la bla ma dam pa zhes par 'jog gsung ba sogs lugs mang du yod kyang*/ bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa ni/ rang nyid la bla med kyi dbang rdzogs par bskur ba'i sum ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni/ slob ma de'i bla ma dam pa yin te/ des de la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab na tshe 'di'am bar do sogs su sangs rgyas 'byin nus pa'i phyir/ rgyud tsam bshad pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon sogs dang*/ nyan thos lugs dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs kyi chos tsam bshad pa'i bla ma ni/ slob ma de'i bla ma dam pa ma yin te/ des de la gsol ba btab pa las byin rlabs cung zad 'byung yang*/

myur du sangs rgyas 'byin pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ gzhung nyid las/ de lta'i theg pa gsum po yi// so so'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin// bla ma'i mtshan nyid mi ldan na// bla ma yin gyi dam pa min// de la gsol ba btab na yang*// byin rlabs cung zad 'byung mod kyi// tshe 'di'am bar do la sogs su// sangs (29) rgyas nyid 'byin mi nus so// zhes so// gong gi lugs dang po de ltar na ha cang thal te/ deng sang bla med kyi dbang bskur mdzad mkhan gyi so skye'i rdo rje slob dpon phal che ba bla ma dam pa ma yin par 'gyur bas so// lugs gnyis pa de yang mdzod las/ skyes bu dam pas 'gro ba'i don la de ltar bshad pas 'khrul gzhi byas kyang*/ skyes bu dam pa dang bla ma dam pa cung mi gcig ste/ theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad skyes bu dam pa yin kyang*/ bla ma dam pa yin pa'i nges pa med pa'i phyir/ des na rang nyid kyis sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom chog pa'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma dam pa don gcig cing*/ de'i gnad kyis slob ma de'i bla ma dam par 'gyur ba la/ slob ma de la bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur mkhan gyi bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yin dgos par grub bo// gnyis pa ni/ dad ces pa bshad gzhir byas/ yul gang la na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i nang tshan sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gsung rab la blo gros kyi lus stobs rgyas pa'i seng ge'i sgra yis/ lta grub ngan pa'i ri dwags mtha' dag skrag par mdzad cing*/ rang nyid bshad sgrub thams cad sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin legs par bsgrub pa gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i rje btsun bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan de la'o// gang zag gang dad na/ rtsom pa po bdag cag rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'o// ṭīka byed kha cig dad ces pa rgyur byas nas skyon med ces so nas phyag 'tshal yul ston byed la byas pa'i bshad pa mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/
dad ces pa de la dad yul dngos su ma smos na de ltar bden yang*/ de ni gong du smos zin pa'i phyir te/

(30) bde gshegs bstan pa'i zhes pa nas/ mtshungs med bla ma de la zhes pa'i bar ni dad yul ston byed yin pa'i phyir ro// des na mchod brjod kyi mthar dad dang 'dud dang phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod ces pa sogs gang sbyar kyang khyad par med cing don 'dra ba yin te/ mkhas 'jug las/ mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can// shis pa brjod sogs mi 'gal te// thams cad du yang ston pa yi// che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ mchod par brjod pa de tsam nges sam zhe na/ der ma zad sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i skyon med cing*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' ba 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba yin no// zhes pa la skyon med ces sogs byung*/ sngon gyi tshad thub 'grel chen phal cher dang phyis byon gyi mkhas pa mang dag kyang*/ sdom gsum gyi dbu'i mchod brjod gsum ka gtso bor rje btsun rin po che nyid la yin no zhes mgrin dbyangs gcig tu sgrog par mdzad/ bdag cag gi ston pa go bo rab 'byams pa yab sras sogs ni/ mchod brjod rim pa gsum la mchod yul yang mi 'dra ba gsum yod par bzhed pa las/ lugs snga ma de la gzu bo'i blos dpyad na/ skyon 'di ltar gnas te/ 'o na bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la zhes pa'i bla ma dam pa de/ gtso bor rje btsun rin po che nyid yin nam ma yin/ ma yin na rje btsun nyid la mchod par brjod pa dang 'gal/ yin na mtshungs med bla ma de la zhes pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la zhes mchod yul slar yang smos pa 'di zlos par 'gyur te/ de dag thams cad rje btsun rin po che nyid du mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dga' (31) gdong pas snga ma de bla ma spyi dang*/ phyi ma gnyis rje btsun rin po che nyid la yin zhes gsungs pa yang mi 'thad de/ mtshungs med bla ma de la zhes pa dang*/

'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la zhes pa gnyis la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par so sor ma phyes na zlos shing gya tshom du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na lugs phyi ma nyid 'thad pa yin te/ thog mar bla ma dam pa spyi dang*/ rang nyid la tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen dang*/ byang sems kyi sdom pa lugs gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi sdom pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang bskur ba rnams rim can du gnang ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun la mchod par brjod nas/ de nas brgyud pa'i thog mar ston pa sangs rgyas la mchod par brjod pa ni 'brel shin tu legs shing*/ gzhung gzhan dang yang sgo mthun pa'i phyir/ dper na gra ston zhu len sogs las/ thog mar bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te// rdo rje 'chang la gnyis pa'i tshig gis 'dud// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba ci zhig byed pa yin zhe na/ 'di la bshad ces pa bshad gzhir byas/ yul gang la na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa dang ldan zhing bshad sgrub thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gdul bya de la'o// gang bshad na/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'o// gang zag gang gis na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bdag gis so// tshig sbyor ji lta bus 'chad pa yin zhe na/ tshig rgyan dang mngon brjod kyis gtso bor bcings pa mkhas pa rnams dga' ba'i sdeb sbyor ni blun po rnams kyis go dka' bas/ de lta bu'i tshig gi sbyor ba spangs nas kyang mkhas blun kun gyis go sla bar bya ba'i phyir du bshad pa yin te/ (32) bstan bcos 'di ni mkhas blun kun gyis bstan pa'i nyams len ma 'khrul ba shes pa'i ched du brtsams pas so// kun slong gi bsam pa ji lta bus brtsams zhe na/ bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod pas/ bstan pa'i nyams len ma 'khrul pa mi nyams par bya ba'i lhag bsam dang*/

'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la lag len 'khrul par spyod pa rnams la bdag ma dad pas/ de rnams la lhag par brtse ba'i snying rjes kun nas bslang ste brtsams pa yin no// bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dgos pa ni 'di dag gi shugs la bstan pa yin te/ mkhas blun kun la phan pa'i ched dang*/ lag len 'khrul par spyod pa rnams dgag pa'i ched du bstan bcos brtsams pa ni shugs las thon pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa bshad pa rang gi ngo bo la gnyis te/ don la 'khrul pa dgag pa dang*/ tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ brjod bya'i gtso bo ngos gzung ba'i sgo nas lus mdor bstan/ sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len zhib tu bstan pa'i sgo nas yan lag rgyas par bshad/ gnad ma 'khrul bar gdams pa'i sgo nas 'jug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ sdom gsum dbye ba bdag gis bshad// ces pa la 'phros/ bshad par bya rgyu rnams ji lta bu zhe na/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ gsum po de dag len pa'i thabs cho ga dang*/ mi nyams par bsrung tshul so so'i bslab bya dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i nyams len gyi gnad rnams dang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ lam rim pa gnyis kyi gsang tshig dang*/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i ye shes (33) phyag rgya chen po dang*/ phyag chen skye ba'i thabs phyi nang gi rten 'brel dang*/ rten 'brel la brten nas sa dang lam bgrod tshul gyi rnam par bzhag pa ste/ brjod bya'i gtso bo don tshan bcu gcig la 'khrul pa 'gog cing*/ ma 'khrul ba bsgrub pa'i rnam par dbye ba bshad kyis nyon zhes 'doms pa'i tshul du bstan bcos kyi lus rnam par gzhag pa ston pa la/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*// zhes sogs 'byung*/ lus rnam gzhag 'di ltar byas na 'chad pa pos 'chad sla zhing*/ nyan pa pos bzung sla ba'i phan yon yod de/

'chad sla ba dang bzung bde zhing*// bstan bcos la yang rtsod bral phyir// mkhas pa la la bstan bcos lus// bsdus te thog mar 'god par mdzad// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag skabs gang du rgyas par bshad snyam na/ dang po so thar yin pa'i cho ga la/ nyan thos lugs dang*/ theg chen lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas// zhes sogs kyi skabs su rang lugs dang*/ kha cig ji srid 'tsho ba'i sgra// zhes sogs kyi skabs su gzhan lugs bstan/ theg chen lugs la/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid la yang*// zhes sogs kyi cho ga nub ma nub sogs kyis rnam dbye phye nas deng sang lag len gyi cho ga dngos la ngos gzung ba bstan/ so thar gyi bslab bya la yang gnyis las/ theg chen so thar gyi bslab bya'i khyad par ni/ 'di la sdig to mi dge'i phyogs// zhes sogs dang*/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so thar gyis bslab bya ni/ de nas las dang rnam smin gyi// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de man chad kyang bslab bya las 'phros pa dang*/ bslab bya la 'khrul pa 'gog pa nyid ci rigs (34) pa yin no// sems bskyed kyi cho ga ni/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la// zhes sogs dang*/ bslab bya ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// zhes sogs dang*/ sems bskyed kyi nyams len gyi gnad rnams ni/ byang chub sems kyi gnad 'phyugs na// zhes pa man chad kyis bstan/ de bzhin du/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga dang*/ bslab bya ni/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang*// zhes sogs dang*/ kha cig gsang sngags gsang ba la// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can ni/ skabs gsum par/ des na chig thub 'di 'dra'i lugs// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa med// thub pas stong nyid bsngags pa ni// dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog phyir yin// zhes pa nas/ thabs dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyis// mya ngan 'das par 'gyur phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin te/

de dag tu stong pa rkyang ba bsgom pa de bkag nas/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'brel pa'i thabs shes zung 'jug dgos tshul rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'og tu gnad rnams ma 'khrul bar gdams pa'i skabs su yang*/ chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yang*// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu// mdo rgyud kun las rgyal bas gsungs// la la spros bral rkyang pa ni// dkar po chig thub yin zhes zer// 'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir bstan gyi stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can ni mdo sngags thun mong ba'i lam dang*/ rgyas bshad skabs gsum par yod pa ni rnam dpyod kyi mig bus mthong dgos so// rim gnyis kyi gsang tshig la/ rim (35) gnyis mi dgos par 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med// ces sogs dang*/ rim gnyis dngos la 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ brgya la bskyed rim bsgom na yang*// zhes sogs dang*/ gtum mo bsgom pa phal cher yang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ ye shes phyag rgya chen po ni// phyag rgya chen po bsgom na yang*// zhes sogs dang*/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel ni/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// zhes pa nas bzung ste spyod par rgyu ba'i skabs rnams kyi bstan pa yin te/ lus dang ngag gi brda rnams la// legs par sbyangs shing de nyid rtogs// sa rnams bgrod par bya ba dang*// yul rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs// yul chen sum cu so bdun du// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod phyir rgyu// zhes bshad pa dang*/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ de yang phyi nang gi rten 'brel gang yin zhe na/ rang rgyud la bla med kyi sa dang po'i rtogs pa skyes pas phyi'i gnas kyi yul chen bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dbang du 'dus pa ni phyi'i rten 'brel dang*/

nang gi spyi bo dang spyi gtsug la sogs pa'i gnas bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thims shing*/ dbu ma'i mdud pa dang po grol ba ni nang gi rten 'brel dang*/ de bzhin mdud pa gnyis pa sogs pa yang mtshon nas shes par bya ste/ gzhung nyid las/ phyi ru yul rnams bgrod pa dang*// nang du rtsa mdud grol ba ni// sa bcu la sogs bgrod pa yi// rten 'brel nyid kyis 'byung ba yin// zhes so/ (36) sa lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ kha cig 'tshang rgya ba la sa lam mi dgos par 'dod pa nga*/ dbang bzhi dang lam bzhi'i rnam gzhag med par rdo rje theg pa'i sku bzhi thob par 'dod pa sogs nas rtse gcig spros bral/ ro gcig bsgom med kyi rnal 'byor dang bzhi/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sogs dang rim bzhin sbyor bar 'dod pa rnams dgag pa ni/ kha cig sa lam ma bgrod par// rdzogs sangs rgya bar 'dod pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ ci ste 'phags pa'i sar byed na// mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin te/ don 'di dang mthun par sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu las kyang*/ sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag la// kha cig sa lam mi dgos zer// zhes sogs bshad snang bas so// so so thar dang byang chub sems bskyed pa// len pa'i thabs dang mi nyams bslab bya'i tshul// gnyis gnyis sgo nas mdor bstan skabs gnyis su// rgyas bshad blo gros mig phyes gsal bar mthong*// dbang gi cho ga bslab bya'i dam tshig dang*// rim gnyis gsang tshig ye shes phyag chen dang*// phyi nang rten 'brel sa lam rnam par bzhag /mdor bstan lus drug gsum par rgyas par bshad// sems bskyed gnad ni gnyis pa'i sgos chos dang*// stong nyid snying rje mdo sngags thun mong las// gzhung gi 'phros las gsum par rgyas bshad tshul// zab gsal rgya che'i blo yis 'di na rtogs// gzhan dag 'jam dbyangs dgongs pa rang bzo yis// yon po'i lam du 'chad tshul sna tshogs kyi// rnam rtog ri mo mang yang ngal ba tsam// kun kyang nges gsang bdud

(37) rtsi 'di len rigs// zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ dngos kyi don dang*/ gzhung spyi la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ so thar gyi nyams len/ byang sems kyi nyams len/ sngags sdom gyi nyams len bshad pa'o// dang po la/ len byed kyi cho ga bshad pa/ bsrung tshul gyi bslab bya bshad pa/ zhar la thos sgom gyi gnad ma 'khrul bar bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ gnyis su dbye ba dang*/ so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*// zhes pa la 'phros/ so thar gyi sdom pa chos can/ khyod len tshul gyi cho ga de la gnyis su yod de/ nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa ltar gyi len tshul dang*/ theg chen gyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa ltar gyi len tshul gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nyan thos so thar dang*/ theg chen so thar ro// dang po la gsum ste/ rigs bdun len tshul spyir bstan/ de la log rtog dgag pa/ bsnyen gnas bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ dam bca' dgod pa dang*/ sgrub byed bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas pa'i dge bsnyen pha ma/ dge tshul pha ma'i sdom pa sogs nas skyabs 'gro rtsom byed la ma ltos pa'i dge slong pha ma'i sdom pa'i bar rigs bdun ni chos can/ khyod len pa'i dus yod de/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du len pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ khyod gtong ba'i dus kyang yod de/ rten gyi gang zag shi ba'i tshe na gtong ba'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ sdom pa de rnams kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni tshe 'phos nas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ tshe 'dir tshul khrims rnam dag (38) bsrung ba ni phyi ma mtho ris kyi lus rten thob byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ mtho ris don du tshul khrims dang*// 'bral ba'i don du bsgom gtso'i phyir// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

sdom pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu sogs ni tshe 'dir yang 'gyur ba yin te/ sdom pa rnam par dag pa las rang rgyud dge ba la goms pa dang*/ 'jig rten kun gyi dad pa'i yul du 'gyur ba sogs kyi phan yon ches mang ba zhig ni/ tshe 'dir yang thob pas so// 'o na byang sems so thar gyi sdom pa rnams kyang shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ngam zhe na/ de rnams chos can/ shi 'phos pa'i tshe na mi gtong ste/ rten gyi gang zag shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang ba'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos so thar gyi rten gyi gang zag shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ba dang*/ byang sems so thar de'i tshe mi gtong ba de dag gi ni rgyu mtshan yang bshad par bya'o// gang zhe na/ nyan thos so thar gyi sdom pa rten gyi gang zag shi ba'i tshe na gtong ba la sgrub byed yod de/ de rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ de gzugs can yin tshul ni/ rang rgyud ldan gyi lus ngag gi gzugs can nyer len gyi rgyur byas pa las skye bar 'dod pas gzugs can yin par grub ste/ rang rgyu bem po zhig gis nyer len gyi rgyu byas pa las byung ba yin na bem po yin dgos so// rang rgyu shes pa zhig gis nyer len gyi rgyu byas pa las byung ba yin na/ shes pa yin dgos pa ni rig pa smra ba'i spyi lugs yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las kyang*/ rnam shes min pa rnam shes kyi// nyer len min pa'i phyir yang grub// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos so thar rten gyi gang zag shi ba'i tshe gtong ba 'di ni lung gis kyang 'grub

(39) ste/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/ bslab pa phul ba dang*/ rten gyi gang zag shi 'phos pa dang*/ pho mo'i mtshan gnyis cig char tu byung ba dang*/ las 'bras med par lta ba'i log ltas dge rtsa chad pas so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba rigs brgyad char dang*/ mtshan mo 'das pas bsnyen gnas so thar gtong bar gsungs pa ni nyan thos so thar gyi gtong tshul 'di la lung tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ gong gi byang sems so thar gyi sdom pa ni chos can/ gzugs can ma yin te/ rang gi nyer len sems las skyes pas shes par 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/ des na sdom pa 'di ni ji srid sems ma nyams kyi bar du yod pa yin te/ byang chub snying po'i mtha' can gyi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi dgongs pa yang ni don 'di nyid yin te/ byang sems so sor thar pa'i mdo dang*/ chos gzhi bstan pa'i mdo sogs las kyang so thar shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud sogs las kyang*/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// zhes pa nas/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// zhes dang*/ slob dpon bha'u ri bas/ bdag kyang deng nas byang chub bar// lus dang srog la ltos med par// bslab rnams mgon bzhin bsrung la gnas// ye shes thugs kyi dgongs su gsol// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang (40) de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir spos khang pa dang*/ dga' gdong pa sogs ṭīka byed phal cher gyis zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i mdo dang*/ nor bu thig le'i rgyud kyi lung 'dren par mdzad pa ni ji ltar 'thad brtag dgos te/

skabs 'di'i byang sems sdom pa sems bskyed kyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i sdom pa yin na lung 'dren de ltar 'thad kyang*/ 'di ni so thar gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa yin pa'i phyir te/ so thar la/ nyan thos so thar dang*/ byang sems so thar gnyis su dbye nas/ dang po shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ba nyan thos kyi lugs dang*/ phyi ma shi 'phos nas kyang rdzas su 'brang ba theg chen gyi lugs yin pa'i rnam dbye phye ba ni gzhung 'di dag gi skabs don yin pa'i phyir/ de yang 'bri gung pa dag nyan thos so thar sems ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du len pas shi 'phos na kyang rjes su 'brang bar 'dod pa nyan thos theg chen du 'chos pa dang*/ yang phyogs snga ma kha cig theg chen lugs kyi so thar sdom pa yang rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yin zer ba lta bu theg chen nyan thos su 'chos pa rnams dgag par bzhed nas/ nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min// zhes sogs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni// sems las skye phyir gzugs can min// zhes sogs gsungs pa yin te/ skabs gnyis par yang*/ nyan thos kyi ni sdom pa la// theg pa chen por 'chos pa dang*// de bzhin theg chen nyan thos su// 'chos pa tshul khrims ma dag pa// zhes gsungs pa yang dgag bya 'di dag la dgongs pa yin no// 'o na/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// zhes sogs de/ 'dir lung du 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin (41) snyam na/ lung des ni rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig la tshul khrims gsum du phye ba bstan cing*/ tshul khrims de gsum ga byang chub snying po'i mtha' can yin pa ni tshig gong ma/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// zhes pa de/ spyi'i dam tshig dang so so'i dam tshig gi dbang bskur yang sbyor bas thon la/ tshul khrims gsum gyi nang nas/ dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ so thar gyi ldog pa nas bstan pas/ 'dir bstan rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang 'brel ba'i byang sems so thar du ngos 'dzin byas na legs pa yin no// gong gi nyan thos so thar gyi skabs su dogs pa 'di 'byung ste/

nyan thos so thar shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ba'i sgrub byed du mdzod kyi lung drangs nas de ltar du sgrub nus na/ nyan thos so thar gzugs can yin pa'i sgrub byed du/ rnam rig min rnam gsum zhes bya// zhes so// mdzod kyi lung drangs pas kyang de ltar du bsgrub nus par 'gyur ro zhe na/ lan ji ltar bya/ dga' gdong pa sogs khong rang gi grub mtha'i 'dod thog tu snang*/ rang lugs la cung dka' bar snang*/ rang gi bsam tshod bstan bcos mdzad pa 'di'i dgongs pa/ nyan thos so thar gzugs can yin pas shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ba dang*/ byang sems so thar gzugs can ma yin pas shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang ba dngos bstan bsnyon med du gsal bas gzhung rtsa ba'i rjes su 'brang ngo*// gnyis pa log rtog dgag pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ 'bri gung pa kha cig ji srid 'tsho'i mtha' can yin pas shi ba'i tshe gtong bar ma nges te/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i sgra la gnyis las/ lus ji srid 'tsho ni ji srid ma shi'i bar dang*/ sems ji srid (42) 'tsho ni ji srid rig pa rgyun ma chad kyi bar la dgongs pas so thar gyi sdom pas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar len pa 'di sems bskyed dang sdom pa brku thabs mi bya ba thabs la mkhas pa'i g.yo sgyu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sgrub byed med par bstan pa/ gnod byed rgyas par bshad pa/ smad pa'i gnas su bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i so thar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du len pa'i lag len de 'dra mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin zhing*/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gzhung las kyang de 'dra ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gnod byed kyi rig pa dngos dang*/ de'i nyes spong gi lan dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi gzhung nas bshad pa dang*/

theg chen gyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i sdom pa gnyis la khyad par med par 'gyur te/ de gnyis ka dus byang chub snying po'i bar du len pa de lta yin pa'i phyir na'o// yang skyabs 'gro la nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis su dbyer mi rung bar thal ba dang*/ sdom pa de gnyis 'bog pa'i cho ga yang gcig tu thal ba dang*/ sdom pa de gnyis kyi bslab bya yang gcig tu thal bar 'gyur te/ len pa'i dus kyi khyad par gcig pa de'i phyir ro// gnod byed gzhan yang bslab pa phul ba dang*/ mtshan gnyis cig char du byung ba dang*/ log ltas dge rtsa chad pa sogs sdom pa'i gtong rgyu gzhan gyis kyang dge slong gi sdom pa gtong ba mi srid par 'gyur te/ shi 'phos pa'i tshe yang dge slong gi sdom pa mi 'dor ba'i phyir (43) na'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nyes spong brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar byas pa la/ rjes 'brang kha cig skyon spong 'di skad du/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis ma zin pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa gal te shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong na yang*/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i sdom pa gtong ba mi srid ces zer ro// gnyis pa de dgag pa la gsum ste/ gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong bar thal ba/ 'dod na gnod byed gnyis kyi dgag pa/ bsnyen gnas la'ang mtshungs par thal ba'o// dang po ni/ 'o na theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i dge slong la sogs pa'i sdom pa rigs bdun po rnams chos can/ bslab pa phul ba dang*/ shi 'phos pa dang*/ log ltas dge rtsa chad pa la sogs pa gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong bar 'gyur te/ sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i gnad kyis shi 'phos kyang mi gtong bar khas blangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong ba la 'dod pa yin no// zhe na/ 'o na sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i dge slong gi sdom ldan des dge slong gi sdom pa phul yang bsrung dgos par 'gyur zhing*/

ma bsrungs na dge slong gi sdom pa nyams par 'gyur te/ bslab pa phul ba la sogs pa gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong ba de lta yin pa'i phyir na'o// yang sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i dge slong de shi 'phos nas gang du skyes kyang dge slong du 'gyur bar thal/ gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong ba de'i phyir ro// de la yang gal te 'dod na/ sems bskyed kyis zin pa de ni lhar skyes na lha'i dge slong srid par gyur zhing*/ mir skyes na yang byis pa chung ngu la blang mi dgos par dge slong du 'gyur ba dang*/ byis pa de la srog (44) gcod la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung bar gyur na dge slong gi sdom pa nyams par 'gyur zhing*/ nyams nas gsang 'dod kyi 'chab sems skyes pa la slar dge slong gi sdom pa blang du med par gsungs te/ 'dul ba sum brgya ba las/ mi gsod la sogs gzhi rnams kyis// dge tshul las ni nyams gyur na// dge slong bzhin du dge tshul la'ang*// phyi nas sdom skye'i skal ba med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ lhar skyes na lha'i dge slong du 'gyur ba sogs la yang 'dod do zhe na/ 'dod mi nus te/ lha dang byis pa'i dge slong ni 'dul ba'i sde snod las bkag pa'i phyir te/ mdo rtsa bar/ mi ma yin gyi 'gro ba pa dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa gnyis ni sdom pa'i zhing nyid ma yin no// zhes dang*/ las kyi gzhir/ lo nyi shu ma lon pa ma yin nam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'dul bar byis pa'i dge slong ye ma bshad dam zhe na/ spyir btang la skyes pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa la lo nyi shu lon pa zhig dgos kyang*/ dmigs bsal la lo bco brgyad dang lo bcu dgu gang rung gi tshe lo nyi shu lon par 'khrul nas lo nyi shu lon snyam pa'i 'du shes kyi sgo nas dge slong gi sdom pa blangs na chags pa yin te/ mdo rtsa bar/ rnam pa thams cad du lo nyi shu lon pa la ni bsnyen par rdzogs pa chags so// gcig shos la ni lon par 'du shes pa nyid na'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

bud med la khyim so bzung ba yin na lo bcu gnyis ma la bsnyen par rdzogs par yang bshad pas nyes med phun tshogs kyi byis pa'i dge slong ma yod par khas len te/ mdo rtsa ba las/ khyim so bzung ba de bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba'i lo rnams kyi dang po ni bcu gnyis nyid do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bsnyen gnas (45) la mtshungs par thal ba ni/ bsam pa theg chen sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yang chos can/ dus rtag tu bsrung dgos par 'gyur zhing*/ ma bsrungs na bsnyen gnas nyams par 'gyur bar thal/ nangs par mtshan mo 'das phan chad kyang mi gtong bar byang chub snying po'i bar du yod pa'am gnas pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ gal te gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ nangs par mtshan mo 'das pas sdom pa gtong ngo zhe na/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sdom pa rnams dus rgyun du 'byung bar khas blangs pa dang 'gal te/ sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni mtshan mo 'das pa na gtong ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyan thos gzhung nas bshad pa'i rigs bdun byang chub snying po'i bar du len pa la gnod byed brjod pa des na/ nyan thos so thar sdom brten gyi gang zag shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang ba yod do// zhes smra ba'i skyes bu 'bri gung pa de la ni chos can/ theg pa che chung gi sde snod kyi rnam dbye med par zad de/ mdzod las/ ji srid 'tsho dang nyin zhag tu// sdom pa yang dag blang bar bya// zhes pa ltar/ rang nyid ji srid ma shi'i bar du sdom pa len pa/ ji srid 'tsho'i mtha' dang*/ sang skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du len pa nyin zhag gi mtha' gang rung nyan thos kyi lugs yin pa'i rnam dbye dang*/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// zhes dang*/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// zhes sogs ltar/ snying stobs chen pos sems can gyi don du byang chub snying po'i bar du sdom pa len pa theg pa chen po'i lugs yin pa'i rnam dbye ma phyed 'dug pas so// 'dir phyogs snga mas nyan thos gzhung nas bshad pa'i dge slong

(46) gi sdom pa len pa'i tshe byang chub snying po'i bar du nges par len dgos pa ni mi bzhed la/ 'o na ci zhe na/ dbang po rno 'bring phye nas/ dbang rnon kha cig gis sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dge slong gi sdom pa byang chub snying po'i bar du len par 'dod pas de phyogs sngar byas nas 'dir 'gog pa yin te/ sdom pa shi yang yod do zhes// smra ba'i skyes bu de la ni// zhes dang*/ 'og tu yang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni// byang chub bar du blangs gyur na// so so thar pa ci nas 'jig /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bsnyen gnas bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang*/ log rtog bye brag tu dgag pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi lugs dang*/ theg chen gyi lugs so// dang po ni/ nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas// zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum la 'phros/ nyan thos lugs la rigs bdun ji srid 'tsho'i bar du len na/ yul gang las len zhe na/ nyan thos bye brag smra ba rnams kyi ni rigs bdun dang*/ der ma zad bsnyen gnas kyang yul dge slong las len pa yin te/ gzhan gyi rnam rig byed sogs kyi// zhes pa'i mdzod rang 'grel las/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de yang dge 'dun nam gang zag las te/ dge slong dang dge slong ma dang*/ dge slob ma'i sdom pa rnams ni dge 'dun las so// gzhan dag ni gang zag las so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang dge 'dun dang gang zag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i dge 'dun ni/ dge slong bzhi tshogs pa'am/ dge slong ma bzhi tshogs pa yan chad la 'jog cing*/ de gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i gang zag ni/ dge slong dang (47) dge slong ma gcig gam gnyis sam gsum du gnas pa rnams la ngos 'dzin pa yin no// 'o na 'grel ba 'dis bsnyen gnas dge slong las len pa ji ltar bstan zhe na/ gsal bar bstan pa yin te/

gzhan dag ni zhes pa'i gzhan dag der dge tshul pha ma'i sdom pa/ dge bsnyen pha ma'i sdom pa/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dang lnga po de 'byung rigs pa'i phyir/ gser thur las/ bye smra'i bsnyen gnas dge slong las// len pa'i dmigs bsal gang na yod// ces dri ba mdzad pa de'i lan yang 'di las 'os gzhan med pa yin no// mdzod 'grel dang*/ rab dbye'i dngos bstan de rnams da chog gi dbang du byas par gsal gyis/ spyir btang la ni ma nges te/ rang byung gi bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ tshur shog gi bsnyen rdzogs sogs yul dge slong las thob pa ma yin pas so// rigs bdun dang bsnyen gnas skye ba'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med gang rung las 'gro ba gzhan za ma dang ma ning sogs la sdom pa skye ba bkag ste/ mdzod las/ za ma ma ning sgra mi snyan// mtshan gnyis ma gtogs mi rnams la// sdom min sdom pa'ang de bzhin la// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skye ba'i rten gyi lung khung la mdzod kyi lung 'dren par kun mthun pas/ len pa'i yul gyi lung khung du yang*/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i sdom gsum 'khrul spong du sngar drangs pa'i mdzod 'grel gyi lung 'dren par mdzad pa ni shin tu 'brel chags shing gzhung lugs kyi dgongs par gdon mi za'o// nyan thos mdo sde pa rnams ni dud 'gro sogs 'gro ba gzhan la'ang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skye bar bshad de/ 'dul ba lung las/ klu gzhon nu

(48) tsam pa zhes bya ba dus bzang la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrung ba dang*/ rgya mtsho'i klu rnams dus bzang la rgya mtsho nas 'ongs te bsnyen gnas bsrung bar gsungs pa rnams sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa'i phyir/ bye brag smra bas ni/ de rnams bsnyen gnas nyin zhag phyed pa la dgongs par 'dod cing*/ bsnyen gnas nyin zhag phyed pa ni/ bar ma'i dge ba tsam yin gyis/ sdom pa ni ma yin no// de skad du/ mdzod 'grel las/ de las gzhan du nos pas ni legs par spyad pa tsam du 'gyur gyis/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni ma yin no// zhes so// blang ba'i yul yang*/ dge bsnyen dang rab byung sogs gang yang rung ba las blangs pas chog ste/ drang srong gnas mchog gi zhus pa'i mdo las/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ rab tu byung ba cho ga shes pa zhig gi gam du song ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dul ba lung las/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis rang gi 'khor 'bangs rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod par gsungs par yang*/ sgra mi bzhin du khas len pa'i phyir/ nyan thos rnams kyi lugs la/ blang ba'i yul dang*/ len pa'i gang zag de ltar nges par ma zad cho ga'ang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba rtsom byed du byas nas 'bog pa yin no// gnyis pa theg chen gyi lugs ni/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa las gsungs shing*/ yul ni/ rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis blangs pas chog cing*/ cho ga ni sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang cha 'dra bar yod do// rgyu mtshan des na/ nyan thos lugs dang theg chen lugs kyi bsnyen gnas dus gtso cher nyin zhag gi mtha' can du mtshungs kyang*/ cho ga la khyad par yod de/ skyabs 'gro tsam rtsom byed du byas nas gang zag gzhan gyis 'bog pa dang*/ (49) rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis sems bskyed len pa dang 'dra bar len pa'i khyad par so sor yod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/

bsnyen gnas 'bul ba dgag pa/ gzhan la 'chol ba dgag pa/ lha sgom tha dad dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bka' gdams pa la la na re/ bsnyen gnas nyin zhag gcig bsrung ba'i sang nangs par gzhan la 'bul dgos te/ ma phul na de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa byas pa'i tshe nyams par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir zhes zer ro// de dgag pa ni/ bsnyen gnas nyin zhag gcig pa 'di la 'bul mi dgos te/ bsnyen gnas nyin zhag gcig bsrungs pa'i sang nangs par mtshan mo 'das pa ste skya rengs shar ba na gtang ba'i phyir te/ nyin zhag gcig las lhag par bsrung bar khas blangs pa med pa'i phyir/ gal te mdo sde pa'i lugs bzhin du sngon lan cig zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad la bdag bsnyen gnas par gzung du gsol zhes khas blangs nas/ phyis skya rengs shar nas yun 'ga' song zhing zan zos pa'i rjes sogs ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshe/ bsnyen gnas len na yang nangs par gzhan la 'bul mi dgos te/ nangs par skya rengs shar phan chad sdom pa de bsrung ba'i bsam pa med pa'i phyir na nangs par sdom pa gtong bar nges pa de'i phyir na'o// mdo sde pa'i lugs 'di ni gang las bshad snyam na/ nangs par gzhan las nod par bya zhes pa'i mdzod 'grel las/ nangs par ni re zhig nyi ma shar ba'i tshe ste/ nyin zhag gi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir zhes spyir btang dang*/ gang gis tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o// zhes sngon yang dag par blangs pa des ni zan zos nas kyang nod par bya'o// zhes (50) dmigs bsal dang gnyis gsungs pa'i/ dmigs bsal 'di mdo sde pa'i lugs bzhin du ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshe bsnyen gnas len zhes pa de yin par 'chad do// 'dir paṇa chen rin po che'i legs bshad gser thur las/ mdo sde pa yi lugs bzhin du// ji ltar 'dod tshe len zhes pa// dus gcig stabs su len nam ci// zas zos nas kyang len zhes pa// 'di yi don du khas len na// de 'dra bye brag smra ba yi// nangs par gzhan las nod ces pa'i// dmigs bsal yin phyir skabs kyi ni// rtsod pa'i lan du 'gyur ba med// ces mdo sde pa'i lugs yin par 'gog par mdzad kyang*/

mdzod rtsa 'grel kun bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' yin pa'i nges pa med de/ mdzod rtsa ba dang dngos bstan gyi 'grel pa phal mo che bye smra'i lugs dang*/ lo grag zer gsum gyi thad kyi 'grel pa dang*/ 'phros don gyi 'grel pa phal cher ni mdo sde pa'i lugs yin par mkhas pa dag la yongs su grags pa yin no// des na nangs par ni re zhig ces sogs 'grel pa snga ma de bye smra'i lugs dang*/ gang gis tshes brgyad la zhes sogs 'grel pa phyi ma las 'phros pa'am/ dmigs bsal gyi tshul du byung ba de mdo sde pa'i lugs yin te/ 'grel pa snga ma'i thad kyi 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las/ sdom pa ni slong bar byed pa yang dag par len par nges pa'i sems pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe kho na skye'o// zan zos nas nod pa ni gsal ba'i phyir ro// zhes nyi ma ste skya rengs shar ba'i tshe len pa kho na bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ gang gis tshes brgyad la zhes sogs bye smra rang lugs kyi dmigs (51) bsal yin na 'grel bshad kyang de dang mthun pa zhig dgos pa las/ nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe kho na skye'o zhes pa'i ngos gzung gi tshig gis mi mthun pa dngos su gsal bas/ 'grel bshad de 'dor rigs par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do// gnad kyi don ni bye smras bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa la nyin zhag yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtha' can zhig dgos par bsams nas/ len pa'i tshe yang skya rengs shar ba'i tshe kho na len/ sang yang skya rengs shar ba na gtong ba'i phyag len cung zad dog par snang*/ mdo sde pas dang po lan cig slob dpon las len pa'i tshe/ bdag zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad la bsnyen gnas par gzung du gsol zhes brjod nas/ phyis kyi tshes brgyad byung ngo cog rnams la bsnyen gnas rang nyid kyis blangs nas bsrungs pas chog cing*/ de yang skya rengs shar ba'i tshe len thub na rab/

de'i tshe brjod pa dang g.yeng ba sogs kyis ma thub na/ nyi ma shar lhod pa'am nyi ma snga phyed kyi dus lta bu bza' btung gi bya ba tshar rjes su yang bsnyen gnas blangs nas bsrung chog pas phyag len yangs par snang ngo*// 'di yang gtong tshul sang skya rengs shar ba'i tshe btang bas nyin zhag gi mtha' can du 'gyur yang*/ nyin zhag yongs rdzogs kyi mtha' can ma yin te/ nyin zhag yongs rdzogs ni da nangs skya rengs shar nas/ sang skya rengs ma shar gyi bar la 'jog pa'i phyir/ don 'di dag blo gsal dag gi snying la bcang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos rgyus chung ba la la na re/ bsnyen gnas bsrungs tshar ba'i rjes su gzhan la 'chol dgos te/ ma bcol na slar len du med pa'i phyir zhes smra ba thos so// de ni mi 'thad de/ bsnyen gnas (52) 'chol ba 'di 'dra grub mtha' gang na'ang bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bka' gdams bya yul ba kha cig tshes bco lnga la bsnyen gnas 'phog na lha shākya thub pa dang*/ tshes brgyad la 'bog na sman bla dang*/ gnam stongs la 'bog na snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgom bzlas rnams tha dad du ma byas na dus de dang de la bsnyen gnas bsrung du mi 'dod zer ro// gnyis pa ni/ bsnyen gnas bsrung ba na lha bsgom dgos zer ba 'di yang re zhig mkhas pas brtag par bya ste/ bsnyen gnas ni sdom pa gsum gyi nang nas so sor thar pa'i lugs kyi nyams len/ gtso cher nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa yin zhing*/ yi dam lha'i sgom bzlas ni gsang sngags kyi khyad chos sam gdams ngag yin pas/ nyan thos gzhung nas bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan des na tshes brgyad sogs la bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i tshe lha sgom tha dad ma byas kyang bsnyen gnas nyams par 'gyur pa'i skyon med do// bsnyen gnas nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa gtso che mod/ 'on kyang bsnyen gnas gsang sngags kyi lugs don zhags rtog pa las gsungs pa ltar byed na yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che ste/

rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i gnas skabs yin pas lha sgom pa dang 'brel na phan yon che ba'i phyir/ 'dir paṇa chen rin po ches/ gsang sngags lugs kyi bsnyen gnas la// yi dam bsgom pa mchog yin na// lha de bdag mdun gang yin brtag /bdag bskyed yin na bya rgyud kyi// rang rkang bdag bskyed med pa ci// zhes sogs dri ba mdzad pa la/ kun mkhyen (53) chen po'i 'khrul spong las/ bdag mdun gang yin bsnyen gnas bsrung ba po la dris shig ces bka' stsal kyang*/ 'di ni mdun bskyed nyid du nges pa yin te/ gsang sngags lugs byed na zhes pa'i gsang sngags de don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa theg chen so thar la gnyis te/ nyan par gdams pa dang*/ don dngos so// dang po ni/ nyan thos theg chen lugs gnyis yod// ces pa la 'phros/ theg chen so thar ji lta bu zhe na/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod las byung ba'i so sor thar pa bshad kyis nyon cig ces gdams pa'i tshul du ston pa la tshig rkang gnyis 'byung*/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sngon byung ba'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag dang*/ deng sang gi lag len dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi lugs la ma bltos par/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid la yang*/ so sor thar pa 'bog pa'i cho ga thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' zhig yod de/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ gso sbyong yan lag brgyad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du blang bar gsungs pa dang*/ gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ dge slong ma'i sdom pa ma gtogs pa'i so thar gzhan rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis len par gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa las/ gso sbyong gi sdom pa rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis len par gsungs pa la sogs pa rnams so// de ltar bshad mod kyi/ de dag gi cho ga phal cher ni deng sang nub la/ ma nub pa gang zhe na/ don zhags rtog pa nas gsungs pa ltar gso sbyong gi sdom pa rang gis blang ba dang*/

sogs pa spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa ltar skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa byang (54) chub snying po'i bar du len pa lta bu theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar gyi cho ga'i lag len 'ga' zhig deng sang yang ma nub par yod do// don zhags rtog pa nas bshad pa'i gso sbyong de theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar yin kyang*/ dus nyin zhag gi mtha' can yin te/ don zhags rtog pa nas bshad pa'i// nyin zhag gso sbyong nyams su longs// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar de dag tsam du nges sam zhe na/ sngar bshad pa de dag ni cho ga'i lag len bshad tshod yod pa rang nyid kyis mthong ba rnams yin la/ gzhan yang ming gsal la cho ga mi gsal ba ni/ mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i khyim pa drag shul can gyis zhus par/ rgyal sras byams pas mkhan po mdzad nas khyim bdag dgu stong dang*/ rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs kyis mkhan po mdzad nas khyim bdag bdun stong rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do// zhes pa'i tshig 'bru tsam zhig gsungs mod kyi/ 'on kyang bsnyen rdzogs de'i cho ga ni/ mdo las gsal bar gsungs pa sa paṇ+ḍi ta ngas ma mthong la/ mthong yang deng sang gi so so skye bos byar mi rung ste/ mkhan po byams pa la sogs pa dbu skra ring zhing rgyan dang bcas pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya khyim pa'i cha lugs can bsnyen par rdzogs tshul 'di 'dra ni sngon gyi cho ga 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul kho na yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar gyi cho ga phal cher nub pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas gsungs pa'i bsnyen rdzogs deng sang mi rung ba des na da lta theg chen so thar len pa'i cho ga ni bsam pa theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sgo nas (55) cho ga nyan thos kyi lugs ji lta ba bzhin du bgyis nas len dgos pa yin te/ len tshul de ltar byas na so thar rigs brgyad po gang blangs kyang byang sems so sor thar pa'i sdom par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// cho ga bstan zin to// sdom du byas na/
